# Quotes triggers

## Quote added

Runs when a new quote is saved. Good for a chat reply like "Quote #12 added!".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote user** | Only react to quotes by this person, like "kris". Empty means every quote. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteId%` | The quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The quote's text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |
| `%quoteGame%` | The game or category at the time |
| `%quoteDate%` | The date it was saved |

<small>Type id: `quotes.added`</small>

## Quote edited

Runs when a saved quote is edited, for example its text or who said it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote user** | Only react to quotes by this person, like "kris". Empty means every quote. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteId%` | The quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The quote's new text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |
| `%quoteGame%` | The game or category |

<small>Type id: `quotes.updated`</small>

## Quote removed

Runs when a quote is deleted.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote user** | Only react to quotes by this person, like "kris". Empty means every quote. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteId%` | The deleted quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The deleted quote's text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |

<small>Type id: `quotes.removed`</small>

## Quote shown

Runs when a quote is shown to chat, for example by a !quote command. Good for also showing the quote on screen.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote user** | Only react to quotes by this person, like "kris". Empty means every quote. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteId%` | The quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The quote's text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |
| `%quoteGame%` | The game or category at the time |
| `%quoteDate%` | The date it was saved |

<small>Type id: `quotes.shown`</small>
